missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Шум' is the nominative subject of the sentence. 'Сильный' agrees in the masculine, and 'на улице' marks the prepositional location.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Шум' is the inanimate masculine accusative object of 'подняли', matching the nominative. 'Громкий' agrees in the masculine accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive after 'от'. 'Шума' is genitive following 'от' to express the cause of tiredness. 'Постоянного' agrees in the masculine genitive.
Strategic focus: Prepositional of location. 'В этом шуме' uses the prepositional form 'шуме' after 'в' to mark the surrounding noise. 'Этом' agrees in the masculine prepositional.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after 'с'. 'Шумом' is the instrumental governed by 'с', describing the accompanying sound. 'Громким' agrees in the masculine instrumental.
Strategic focus: Genitive after 'без'. 'Шума' is genitive following 'без' to express absence. 'Спокойно' describes the resulting calm.
Strategic focus: Dative after 'привыкнуть к'. 'Шуму' is the dative governed by 'к', expressing what one is used to. 'Городскому' agrees in the masculine dative.
Strategic focus: Genitive after 'из-за'. 'Шума' is genitive following 'из-за' to express the cause. The phrase models a common complaint.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Шумы' is the nominative plural subject of the sentence. 'Разные' agrees in the plural, and 'слышны' is the short-form predicate.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural. 'Шумов' is the genitive plural, expressing the sources of which sounds. 'Источники' is the accusative plural object of 'изучает'.
